name: Login Page Styler – Custom Login Page Designer  – Admin Login Security – Logo
author: Zia Imtiaz

sections.description:
Login Page Styler is the ultimate WordPress plugin to fully customize and secure your login page. Transform your WordPress login page into a beautifully branded experience with zero coding!

Whether you’re running an eCommerce store, membership site, or client project, make your login page match your brand’s identity with our powerful yet easy-to-use customizer.

🔥 Key Features:

Live Login Page Customizer – Change colors, fonts, backgrounds, and more instantly.

Pre-Designed Login Templates – Choose from professionally designed login page templates.

Custom Logo & Branding – Replace the WordPress logo with your own and set up custom messages.

Custom Backgrounds & Layouts – Add images, videos, gradients, or solid colors.

Google reCAPTCHA Protection – Secure your login page against bots and brute-force attacks.

Custom Login URL – Hide wp-login.php and set your own login URL for enhanced security.

Login Redirects – Automatically redirect users after login or logout based on user roles.

Custom CSS & JS Support – Add your own styles and scripts for advanced customization.

Login Logs & Activity Tracking – Monitor login activity, failed attempts, and security threats.

IP & Region Blocking – Block unwanted visitors from accessing your login page.

🚀 Why Choose Login Page Styler?

Easy to Use – No coding required, just customize and publish.

Lightweight & Fast – Optimized for performance and security.

Mobile Responsive – Looks great on all devices.

Regular Updates – Always compatible with the latest WordPress versions.

Dedicated Support – Get help when you need it!

sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.

  2. Search for Login Page Styler.

  3. Click Install Now and then Activate.

  4. Go to Settings > Login Page Styler to start customizing!
sections.faq:
1. Can I use this plugin without coding knowledge?
    Yes! Login Page Styler is beginner-friendly and requires no coding at all.

  2. How do I add a custom logo to the login page?
    Go to Login Page Styler Settings and upload your logo in the customization panel.

  3. How can I improve the security of my login page?
    Enable Google reCAPTCHA, change the login URL, and monitor login logs using our premium features.

  4. Is the plugin GDPR compliant?
    Yes! We do not collect or store any personal user data
